newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes take holiday, markets to return Monday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes take holiday, markets to return Monday.

text.p: U.S. crudes were on holiday Friday, extending the official American Thanksgiving Day break through a long weekend, leaving values steady until Monday.

Domestic cash prices were in limbo with the NYMEX closure both Thursday and Friday. Brent trading in London moved some spread numbers around, but markets were only notionally talked in the U.S., waiting for the start of ACCESS trade late Sunday and the regular hours market on Monday morning.
Late short covering boosted January IPE Brent nearly 20 cents a barrel. Spot Brent cargoes firmed on the fact all five Brent dates were kept and tight Urals availability.
